## **Securing Every Environment at the Speed of Frontier AI**


### Recognized as a Leader for the second consecutive time


**and positioned furthest for Completeness of Vision.** Palo Alto Networks is advancing hybrid mesh firewall with one integrated platform for preemptive protection, agentic operations, AI runtime security and quantum-safe security across the enterprise.


We are proud to share that Palo Alto Networks has been named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Hybrid Mesh Firewall for the second consecutive time, and **positioned furthest for Completeness of Vision.**


We believe this recognition reflects the strength of our approach to network security: one natively integrated platform that delivers consistent protection, policy and operations across every environment.


It also comes at a pivotal moment for cybersecurity. Frontier AI is collapsing the time between vulnerability discovery and exploitation. AI applications and agents are creating new infrastructure and data risks. At the same time, the cryptographic reset is forcing enterprises to rethink how they establish and maintain digital trust.


Fragmented firewall architectures and manual security operations were never designed for this speed, scale or complexity, and can no longer keep pace.


## **One Platform Across Every Environment**


Hybrid environments have traditionally required organizations to deploy and manage different security products across data centers, clouds, branches, campuses and remote users. The result is often fragmented policy, inconsistent protection and operational complexity.


Palo Alto Networks transforms hybrid mesh firewall from a collection of enforcement products into a unified, intelligent security platform, powered by Precision AI.


The


[Strata Network Security Platform](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/network-security) is our Hybrid Mesh Firewall, spanning hardware


[(PA-Series)](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/network-security/hardware-firewall-innovations) , virtual (


[VM-Series](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/network-security/software-firewalls) ), cloud-native


[(Cloud NGFW)](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/network-security/software-firewalls) and firewall-as-a-service (


[SASE](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/network-security/software-firewalls) ) deployments with consistent policy, shared intelligence and threat prevention across environments.


[Strata Cloud Manager](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/network-security/strata-cloud-manager?utm_source=google-panw_inhouse-amer-sase-smco-sfow&utm_medium=paid_search&utm_campaign=google-sase-smco-amer-multi-consideration-en-brand-phr-t1-SCM&utm_content=000000000000000000&utm_term=strata%20cloud%20manager&cq_plac=&cq_net=g&gclsrc=aw.ds&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=24096949846&gbraid=0AAAAADHVeKkjdmDnCBnBwFB9O7V3Yu5xf&gclid=Cj0KCQjw5P7UBhDaARIsAOSlS1PozrTIMAa43MXyTtEVXACQkG06a7Q70FFKSbbTmRyh1SpcefIkPfAaAiN5EALw_wcB) provides unified policy, visibility and AI-driven operations across these enforcement points. Beyond traditional firewall environments, the platform extends protection to the browser with


[Prisma Browser](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/sase/prisma-browser) and to AI applications, models and agents with


[Prisma AIRS®](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/prisma/prisma-ai-runtime-security) .


[Cloud-delivered security services](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/network-security/security-subscriptions) , including Advanced Threat Prevention, Advanced WildFire, Advanced URL Filtering, and Advanced DNS Security deliver consistent, inline prevention across environments. Intelligence discovered in one part of the platform can strengthen protection everywhere, turning every enforcement point into a real-time prevention layer.


If you’re new to the concept of HMF, explore our primer on


[What Is a Hybrid Mesh Firewall and Why It Matters](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/blog/2025/08/hybrid-mesh-firewall-and-why-it-matters/) .


## **The Hybrid Mesh Firewall Market Is Evolving**


Gartner’s 2026 Hybrid Mesh Firewall research describes a market moving toward more automated, intelligence-driven security platforms as organizations manage increasingly complex hybrid environments.


The report identifies several trends shaping the evolution of hybrid mesh firewall, including the growing adoption of cloud-based management, AI-driven threat prevention, automation through LLM-based assistants, post-quantum cryptography and security capabilities for AI applications and workloads.


As these requirements evolve, organizations need a network security architecture that can deliver consistent protection and operations across hybrid environments while preparing for emerging AI and quantum-era risks.


## **Advancing Hybrid Mesh Firewall for the Frontier AI Era**


Against this backdrop, Palo Alto Networks continues to advance the Strata Network Security Platform for the Frontier AI era.


**Preempt attacks earlier:** Advanced Threat Prevention Plus uses Frontier AI-powered vulnerability discovery and Frontier Virtual Patching to deliver preemptive protections, including before vulnerabilities are publicly disclosed or official patches are available.


**Disrupt attacker infrastructure:** Advanced IP Defense continuously identifies, validates and blocks attacker-controlled infrastructure in real time - even when adversaries use direct-to-IP communications, proprietary encryption, residential proxies or trusted cloud infrastructure to evade traditional security signals.


**Operate at machine speed:** Six purpose-built Network Security Agents in Strata Cloud Manager assist teams with deployment, troubleshooting, configuration management, posture optimization, threat investigation and data protection, with built-in guardrails and human oversight.


**Secure AI and modernize digital trust:** Prisma AIRS helps secure AI applications, models and agents across the AI lifecycle, while Quantum-Safe Security and Next-Generation Trust Security help organizations identify cryptographic risk and modernize digital trust. Read more about


[Palo Alto Networks’ approach to securing AI.](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/blog/ai-security/palo-alto-networks-named-company-to-beat-in-ai-security-for-second-consecutive-year/)


Together, these capabilities help organizations reduce exposure before attacks succeed, operate at machine speed, secure AI infrastructure and modernize digital trust for the post-quantum era.


## **Proven Security, Performance and Scale**


A unified platform must deliver not only breadth, but also effective protection and reliable performance under demanding conditions.


Independent


[SecureIQLab testing](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/network-security/2026-secureiqlab-report) demonstrated 99% security efficacy, with Palo Alto Networks scoring approximately 20 points higher than the next-best tested vendor. Miercom validation demonstrated up to 2–8 times higher AI traffic throughput, along with strong TLS inspection and stable performance under sustained load.


More than 75,000 organizations around the world rely on Palo Alto Networks to consolidate security, improve visibility and reduce risk across their hybrid environments.


This global scale provides intelligence that continuously strengthens the platform. Every attempted attack expands what the platform can learn, and every new detection can become protection for all customers.


## **Defining the Future of Hybrid Mesh Firewall**


We believe being named a Leader for the second consecutive time reinforces our conviction in an integrated platform that delivers consistent prevention and operations everywhere an enterprise operates.


But we believe industry leadership is also about preparing customers for what comes next.


As Frontier AI accelerates attacks, autonomous systems reshape security operations and quantum risk changes the foundations of digital trust, enterprises need more than a collection of firewalls. They need an intelligent security platform that can transform shared intelligence into prevention across every environment.


Palo Alto Networks is building that future, helping organizations reduce exposure before attacks succeed, operate at machine speed, secure AI infrastructure and modernize digital trust for the post-quantum era.
